paragraphs.text: Rosimyffenbip Wuzfeddlims ("Rosie") is a first-year student at Lorehold College of Strixhaven University. Energetic and mischievous, Rosie combines a fierce competitive spirit with an infectious enthusiasm for roleplaying and athleticism.

Rosimyffenbip is proud of her full name but allows only close friends, teachers, staff, or fellow students to call her “Rosie.” She speaks rapidly with vibrant energy, often leaving listeners breathless from keeping up. Her speed of movement surpasses normal expectations, leaving observers unsure whether it's magic, gnomish technology, or sheer force of will driving her swift pace.

As a referee for Strixhaven's rough-and-tumble silkball games, Rosie is known for strict fairness and swift whistle blows. Those who draw her ire during matches find themselves quickly penalized. Outside the sports fields, Rosie is an enthusiastic member of the Live-Action Roleplaying Guild, where she exclusively plays " monster " roles, gleefully chasing down fellow participants to "devour" them amid raucous giggles and fast dashes.

Rosie's boundless energy has a way of propelling not only herself but those around her. Friends who spend time with her find their movements becoming more efficient and purposeful. Whether navigating crowded halls or trekking across campus, they seem to arrive at destinations in record time — often in half the time it would normally take — thanks to Rosie's infectious momentum and knack for shortcuts.

For her rivals, however, Rosie's presence can bring an odd streak of misfortune on the athletic field. During casual games or practice matches, referees and officials often seem hyper-attuned to their slightest missteps. These students find themselves frequently penalized for minor fouls, though curiously, this phenomenon tends to subside during major sporting events like the Battle of Strixhaven.
